results.q: How is the competitor activity index calculated?
results.answer:
The Competitor Activity Index measures competitor activity per 30 days based on event types and their price impacts. 

Each competitor event is assigned a base weight depending on the event type:
• Price Cut: weight of 3
• New Launch: weight of 2
• TV Campaign: weight of 1

Each event is scaled by (1 + |Price Impact %| / 10), and the overall formula is SUM(weight × (1 + |Price Impact %| / 10)) × 30 / days in period. A lower index score is better, and the metric is recorded at the manufacturer level rather than per brand.

results.q: How are competitors matched to our variants?
results.answer: Competitors are matched to our variants strictly based on SubCategory, while Category is ignored since SKUs span multiple categories. Each core variant competes with every external SKU sharing its SubCategory. Rivals are categorized across three tiers: same brand's other variants, other Reckitt core brands, and external competitor brands. A core brand's closest rival is defined as the external brand present across the highest number of that core brand's variants.
